title: cassine albens
intro: Cassine albens, commonly known as White Cassia, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is valued for its various health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cassine albens include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, making it useful in treating various conditions such as wounds, skin irritations, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
